items.name: Implement of Curiosity
items.description: Things didn't get interesting until the first apology.
items.descriptionZh: 直到第一声道歉后，事情才变得有趣起来。

perkDetails.name: Anti-Barrier Hand Cannon
perkDetails.description: Your equipped Hand Cannons fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你装备的手炮会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perkDetails.name: Anti-Barrier Sniper Rifle
perkDetails.description: Your equipped Sniper Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你装备的狙击步枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perkDetails.name: Overload Pulse Rifle
perkDetails.description:
Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你装备的脉冲步枪会发射扰乱子弹，使目标眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perkDetails.name: Overload Submachine Gun
perkDetails.description:
Your equipped Submachine Guns fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你装备的微型冲锋枪会发射扰乱子弹，使目标眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perkDetails.name: Unstoppable Bow
perkDetails.description: Crossbows, and Bows that have been fully drawn for a short time, fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 十字弓和弓箭完全开弓一小段时间后会发射一枚高爆载荷，可眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Stunning Fusion
perkDetails.description:
Aiming down the sights of a Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle for a short time loads a powerful payload that stuns unshielded combatants. 

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
用融合步枪或线性融合步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间会填装强力载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Shield-Shattering Rounds
perkDetails.description: Your Machine Guns fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的机枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perkDetails.name: Impact, Shock, Gravity
perkDetails.description:
Grants access to the Helmet mods: Kinetic/Void Siphon and Kinetic/Arc Siphon.

These mods combine two elemental siphons at a discounted cost.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
可使用头盔模组：动能/虚空虹吸和动能/电弧虹吸。

这些模组以折扣花费组合两种元素虹吸。

perkDetails.name: Gravitic-Voltaic Charge
perkDetails.description: While you have an Arc or Void Super equipped, increase the maximum number of stacks of Armor Charge you can carry by 1.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 装备电弧或虚空超能时，增加1层你可携带的最大护甲充能层数。

perkDetails.name: Expert Handling
perkDetails.description: Weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to stability which resets on weapon reload or stow. Swords gain Guard Resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会赋予可叠加的稳定性加成，填装或收起武器时重置。刀剑获得防御抗性。

perkDetails.name: Fastest Draw
perkDetails.description: If the first shot shortly after reloading or readying your weapon is a precision hit, gain flinch resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 如果填装或举起武器后不久的第一次命中为精准命中，则获得抖动抗性。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Siphon
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。

perkDetails.name: Concentrated Forward Firepower
perkDetails.description: Sustained damage from Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Machine Guns grants those weapons bonus stability, range, and aim assist for a short time.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 来自融合步枪、线性融合步枪和机枪的持续伤害，会在短时间内为这些武器提供额外的稳定性、射程和瞄准辅助。

perkDetails.name: Vanguard Surplus Discounts
perkDetails.description: All Ammo Finder mods are discounted.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 所有弹药搜寻者模组均享有折扣。

perkDetails.name: Press The Advantage
perkDetails.description: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾可以提高武器的稳定性、操控性和填装速度。刀剑可获得更高的防御抗性。

perkDetails.name: Kinetic Synthesis
perkDetails.description: Sustained Kinetic weapon damage and rapid final blows have a chance to generate a unique ammo brick. Collecting this brick will grant ammo to equipped Kinetic damage weapons and grant Special and Heavy ammo progress.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 持续的动能武器伤害和快速最后一击有几率生成独特弹药盒。拾取该弹药盒会为已装备的动能伤害武器提供弹药，同时提供特殊和重型弹药进度。

perkDetails.name: Reload at Range
perkDetails.description: Precision hits with Bows and Sniper Rifles grant a stacking bonus to their reload speed.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用弓箭和狙击步枪的精准命中会为其填装速度提供可叠加的加成。

perkDetails.name: Riposte
perkDetails.description: Shortly after guarding with a Sword, your light and heavy attacks stun unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑格挡后不久，你的轻攻击与重攻击会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Power from Pain
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grant you Devour.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被削弱的战斗人员造成快速最后一击为你提供吞食效果。

perkDetails.name: Fierce Proxemics
perkDetails.description: Finisher final blows grant grenade and melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击提供手雷和近战能量。

perkDetails.name: Rapid Remedy
perkDetails.description: Machine Gun rapid final blows heal you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 机枪快速最后一击会治疗你。

perkDetails.name: Dielectric
perkDetails.description:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败受到电弧减益的目标可获得电光充能。

快速击败受到电弧减益的目标会生成一个能量球并治疗一小部分生命值。

perkDetails.name: Armorsmith
perkDetails.description: Breaking a combatant's shield temporarily grants you damage resistance and increased melee damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾会暂时获得伤害抗性和近战伤害提升。

perkDetails.name: Counter Energy
perkDetails.description: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，你充能最少的技能将获得能量。

perkDetails.name: Combination Argent Blade
perkDetails.description: Briefly pause after executing a light attack, then follow it up with a light or heavy attack to empower your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and charge rate.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在一次轻攻击后稍作停顿，然后接续一次轻攻击或重攻击，可在短时间内强化你的刀剑，赋予其伤害加成和充能速度。

perkDetails.name: Singularity Blade
perkDetails.description: While you have a Void elemental buff, melee and Sword hits weaken targets, while melee and Sword final blows create a weakening burst.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你拥有虚空元素增益时，近战和刀剑命中会削弱目标；近战和刀剑最后一击会产生削弱爆发。

perkDetails.name: Blinding Jolts
perkDetails.description: Final blows on jolted combatants blind nearby combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击会致盲附近的战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Precision Equity
perkDetails.description: Precision final blows build progress towards a large Orb of Power that also grants bonus weapon damage on pickup. Higher ranked targets grant more progress.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会累积进度生成一个大型能量球，拾取后为武器提供额外伤害加成。高等级目标提供更多进度。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Orbs: Arc
perkDetails.description: [Arc]Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去或射击造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

perkDetails.name: Kinetic Rupture
perkDetails.description: Kinetic weapon damage against a powerful combatant has a chance to create a Kinetic Rupture. Targeting this Rupture causes a damaging explosion that staggers combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成动能武器伤害有几率生成一个动能裂口。以此裂口为目标会造成眩晕战斗人员的伤害性爆炸，克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Sniper's Meditation
perkDetails.description: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one hit.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

perkDetails.name: Sword Storm Combo
perkDetails.description: Performing three Sword light attacks followed by a heavy attack summons penumbral blades that surround you to damage and disorient combatants. Sword final blows extend the duration of these penumbral blades.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施展三次刀剑轻攻击后跟进一次重攻击，会召唤出环绕自己的半影利刃，伤害战斗人员并使其迷失。刀剑最后一击可延长半影利刃的持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Void Infestation
perkDetails.description: Defeating a weakened target spawns a tracking projectile that weakens other targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败被削弱目标会生成削弱其他目标的追踪射弹。

perkDetails.name: Tazer Tag
perkDetails.description: Arc-powered melee hits jolt combatants and deal further damage for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧充能近战命中会震颤战斗人员，并在短时间内造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: Sticker Shock
perkDetails.description: Arc Flux, Magnetic, and Fusion Grenades deal more damage when attached to combatants; on final blows, they release several micro-missiles that seek nearby combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧粘性电浆手雷、磁性手雷和融合手雷在黏附到战斗人员时会造成更多伤害；造成最后一击时，释放几枚自动追踪附近战斗人员的微型导弹。

perkDetails.name: Anti-Barrier Hand Cannon
perkDetails.description: Your equipped Hand Cannons fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你装备的手炮会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施展三次刀剑轻攻击后跟进一次重攻击，会召唤出环绕自己的半影利刃，伤害战斗人员并使其迷失。刀剑最后一击可延长半影利刃的持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Void Infestation
perkDetails.description: Defeating a weakened target spawns a tracking projectile that weakens other targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败被削弱目标会生成削弱其他目标的追踪射弹。

perkDetails.name: Tazer Tag
perkDetails.description: Arc-powered melee hits jolt combatants and deal further damage for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧充能近战命中会震颤战斗人员，并在短时间内造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: Sticker Shock
perkDetails.description: Arc Flux, Magnetic, and Fusion Grenades deal more damage when attached to combatants; on final blows, they release several micro-missiles that seek nearby combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧粘性电浆手雷、磁性手雷和融合手雷在黏附到战斗人员时会造成更多伤害；造成最后一击时，释放几枚自动追踪附近战斗人员的微型导弹。

items.note: 旧赛季节点定义，仅用于查阅和保留旧草稿；不是复刻神器的可选节点。

items.name: Implement of Curiosity
items.description:
Works best with:
Elements: [Solar] [Stasis] [Strand] [Kill]
Weapons: [Bow] [Sword] 
items.descriptionZh:
最佳搭配：
元素：   
武器：  

perkDetails.name: Fever and Chill
perkDetails.description: Rapid precision hits with [Solar]Solar weapons grant Radiant. Rapid precision hits with [Stasis]Stasis weapons grant Frost Armor.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用烈日武器快速精准命中目标可获得焕光。使用冰影武器快速精准命中目标可获得冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Benevolence
perkDetails.description: Granting allies an elemental buff gives class ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 为盟友提供元素增益会获得职业技能能量。

perkDetails.name: Frost Renewal
perkDetails.description: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，受到暴击伤害会释放爆发冻结附近的战斗人员，并为你和附近的盟友提供冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Horde Shuttle
perkDetails.description: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a Threadling. Threadlings sever targets that they damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。线虫会对其伤害到的目标施加割裂。

perkDetails.name: Refresh Threads
perkDetails.description: Picking up an Elemental pickup matching your subclass element or picking up a Tangle while you have a [Strand]Strand Super equipped grants energy to your least charged ability.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 装备缚丝超能时，拾取与你分支职业元素相匹配的元素拾取物或拾取缠结会为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

perkDetails.name: Pack Tactics
perkDetails.description: Dealing damage with Threadlings increases Threadling damage. At maximum stacks, Threadlings stun [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用线虫造成伤害可提升线虫伤害。叠满层数时，线虫可眩晕势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Semi-Auto Striker
perkDetails.description: If you have fewer than 2 stacks of Armor Charge, rapid precision shots with Bows, Snipers, and Scout Rifles generate an Armor Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 如果你拥有的护甲充能少于2层，使用弓箭、狙击步枪和斥候步枪快速精准命中会生成一层护甲充能。

perkDetails.name: Threaded Blast
perkDetails.description: Destroying a Tangle with [Strand]Strand damage increases the radius of the explosion and its damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用缚丝伤害摧毁缠结会增加爆炸范围和伤害。

perkDetails.name: Cauterized Darkness
perkDetails.description: [Stasis]Stasis or [Strand] Strand debuffed non-boss combatants take increased [Solar]Solar damage from all sources.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 被冰影或缚丝减益的非首领战斗人员会受到更多来自任何来源的烈日伤害。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Daze
perkDetails.description: Stunning a Champion with an elemental weapon creates an elementally aligned explosion, applying a matching elemental debuff to them and nearby targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用元素武器眩晕一个勇士会产生一次元素对应的爆炸，对其和附近目标施加匹配的元素减益。

perkDetails.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
perkDetails.description: Dealing sustained precision damage against combatants while near two or more allies grants you damage resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在两个或更多盟友附近对战斗人员造成持续精准伤害会获得伤害抗性。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Coalescence
perkDetails.description: Defeating targets has the chance to create an Elemental pickup matching your equipped Super element.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败目标有几率产生与你装备的超能元素匹配的元素拾取物。

perkDetails.name: That Fresh Bullets Smell
perkDetails.description: Picking up an ammo brick gives your Kinetic weapons increased damage for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药盒会在短时间内提升你的动能武器伤害。

perkDetails.name: Energy Acceleration
perkDetails.description: Sustained damage with micro-missiles causes the combatant to emit a Kinetic shockwave that damages nearby combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用微型导弹对战斗人员造成持续伤害，将使其产生伤害周围战斗人员的动能冲击波。克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Radiant Shrapnel
perkDetails.description: Dealing sustained weapon damage while Radiant or defeating a scorched combatant with a weapon causes the target to release Solar projectiles that deal damage and scorch on impact.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在焕光状态下造成持续武器伤害或用武器击败一个灼烧状态的战斗人员，会使目标释放烈日射弹，命中时造成伤害并灼烧。

perkDetails.name: Shieldcrush
perkDetails.description:
While you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or a Void overshield, your melee recharges faster and deals increased damage.

While you are Amplified or Radiant, your grenade recharges faster and deals increased damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，你的近战充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

当你处于增幅或焕光状态时，你的手雷充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Overdrive
perkDetails.description: Picking up an Elemental pickup or Tangle grants increased damage to weapons of the same element.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取元素拾取物或缠结会在短时间内提升同元素武器的伤害。

perkDetails.name: Tangled Web
perkDetails.description: Creating a Tangle by defeating a [Strand]Strand debuffed target suspends nearby combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 通过击败被缚丝减益的目标产生缠结会悬停附近的战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Frigid Glare
perkDetails.description: While Frost Armor is active, [Stasis]Stasis precision final blows cause combatants to release a freezing burst.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 冰霜护甲生效时，冰影精准最后一击会使战斗人员释放冻结爆发。

perkDetails.name: Iron Lord's Vigor
perkDetails.description: While wielding a Sword, you take decreased damage; rapid final blows grant ammo to the wielder.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑时，你受到的伤害降低；快速最后一击可获得弹药。

perkDetails.name: Argent Quiver
perkDetails.description: Reloading a Bow consumes one stack of Armor Charge, granting increased damage and reload speed for your next 3 shots or until you stow your Bow.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 填装弓箭会消耗一层护甲充能，使接下来直至收起弓箭前的3次射击伤害和填装速度获得提升。

items.note: 复刻神器：按官方插槽配置；不代表账号已解锁或当前活动允许使用。

items.name: Encrypted Data Disk
items.description:
Works best with:
Elements: [Kill] [Void] [Arc] 
Weapons: [Sword] [Sniper Rifle] [Machine Gun]
items.descriptionZh:
最佳搭配：
元素：   
武器：  

perkDetails.name: Press The Advantage
perkDetails.description: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾可以提高武器的稳定性、操控性和填装速度。刀剑可获得更高的防御抗性。

perkDetails.name: Kinetic Synthesis
perkDetails.description: Sustained Kinetic weapon damage and rapid final blows have a chance to generate a unique ammo brick. Collecting this brick will grant ammo to equipped Kinetic damage weapons and grant Special and Heavy ammo progress.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 持续的动能武器伤害和快速最后一击有几率生成独特弹药盒。拾取该弹药盒会为已装备的动能伤害武器提供弹药，同时提供特殊和重型弹药进度。

perkDetails.name: Reload at Range
perkDetails.description: Precision hits with Bows and Sniper Rifles grant a stacking bonus to their reload speed.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用弓箭和狙击步枪的精准命中会为其填装速度提供可叠加的加成。

perkDetails.name: Riposte
perkDetails.description: Shortly after guarding with a Sword, your light and heavy attacks stun unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑格挡后不久，你的轻攻击与重攻击会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Power from Pain
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grant you Devour.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被削弱的战斗人员造成快速最后一击为你提供吞食效果。

perkDetails.name: Fierce Proxemics
perkDetails.description: Finisher final blows grant grenade and melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击提供手雷和近战能量。

perkDetails.name: Rapid Remedy
perkDetails.description: Machine Gun rapid final blows heal you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 机枪快速最后一击会治疗你。

perkDetails.name: Dielectric
perkDetails.description:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败受到电弧减益的目标可获得电光充能。

快速击败受到电弧减益的目标会生成一个能量球并治疗一小部分生命值。

perkDetails.name: Armorsmith
perkDetails.description: Breaking a combatant's shield temporarily grants you damage resistance and increased melee damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾会暂时获得伤害抗性和近战伤害提升。

perkDetails.name: Counter Energy
perkDetails.description: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，你充能最少的技能将获得能量。

perkDetails.name: Combination Argent Blade
perkDetails.description: Briefly pause after executing a light attack, then follow it up with a light or heavy attack to empower your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and charge rate.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在一次轻攻击后稍作停顿，然后接续一次轻攻击或重攻击，可在短时间内强化你的刀剑，赋予其伤害加成和充能速度。

perkDetails.name: Singularity Blade
perkDetails.description: While you have a Void elemental buff, melee and Sword hits weaken targets, while melee and Sword final blows create a weakening burst.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你拥有虚空元素增益时，近战和刀剑命中会削弱目标；近战和刀剑最后一击会产生削弱爆发。

perkDetails.name: Blinding Jolts
perkDetails.description: Final blows on jolted combatants blind nearby combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击会致盲附近的战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Precision Equity
perkDetails.description: Precision final blows build progress towards a large Orb of Power that also grants bonus weapon damage on pickup. Higher ranked targets grant more progress.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会累积进度生成一个大型能量球，拾取后为武器提供额外伤害加成。高等级目标提供更多进度。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Orbs: Arc
perkDetails.description: [Arc]Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去或射击造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

perkDetails.name: Kinetic Rupture
perkDetails.description: Kinetic weapon damage against a powerful combatant has a chance to create a Kinetic Rupture. Targeting this Rupture causes a damaging explosion that staggers combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成动能武器伤害有几率生成一个动能裂口。以此裂口为目标会造成眩晕战斗人员的伤害性爆炸，克制势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Sniper's Meditation
perkDetails.description: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one hit.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

perkDetails.name: Sword Storm Combo
perkDetails.description: Performing three Sword light attacks followed by a heavy attack summons penumbral blades that surround you to damage and disorient combatants. Sword final blows extend the duration of these penumbral blades.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施展三次刀剑轻攻击后跟进一次重攻击，会召唤出环绕自己的半影利刃，伤害战斗人员并使其迷失。刀剑最后一击可延长半影利刃的持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Void Infestation
perkDetails.description: Defeating a weakened target spawns a tracking projectile that weakens other targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败被削弱目标会生成削弱其他目标的追踪射弹。

perkDetails.name: Tazer Tag
perkDetails.description: Arc-powered melee hits jolt combatants and deal further damage for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧充能近战命中会震颤战斗人员，并在短时间内造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: Sticker Shock
perkDetails.description: Arc Flux, Magnetic, and Fusion Grenades deal more damage when attached to combatants; on final blows, they release several micro-missiles that seek nearby combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧粘性电浆手雷、磁性手雷和融合手雷在黏附到战斗人员时会造成更多伤害；造成最后一击时，释放几枚自动追踪附近战斗人员的微型导弹。

items.descriptionZh:
最佳搭配：
元素：  

perkDetails.name: Improved Unraveling
perkDetails.description: Increases the amount of damage dealt by unraveling a target.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 提高瓦解目标造成的伤害。

perkDetails.name: Volatile Flow
perkDetails.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants your Void weapons Volatile rounds.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会赋予你的虚空武器不稳定弹药。

perkDetails.name: Unto the Breach
perkDetails.description: Defeating a Void debuffed target creates a Void Breach while your Void or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 装备虚空或棱镜分支职业时击败受虚空减益效果影响的目标可生成一个虚空裂口。

perkDetails.name: Amped Up
perkDetails.description: Stay amplified longer while your Arc or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 装备电弧或棱镜分支职业时增幅状态保持得更久。

perkDetails.name: Thunderous Retort
perkDetails.description: Grants bonus Arc Super damage if cast while critically wounded or while amplified. Lasts until the end of the Super activation.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 在重伤或增幅状态下施放可获得电弧超能伤害加成。持续至超能激活结束。

perkDetails.name: Sustained Fire
perkDetails.description: Continuously damaging combatants or healing allies with an Auto Rifle grants you damage resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用自动步枪持续对战斗人员造成伤害或治疗盟友可提供伤害抗性。

perkDetails.name: Shatter Orbs
perkDetails.description: The first time you break a combatant's shield, you create an Orb of Power if you break the shield with the matching damage type.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 首次击破战斗人员护盾时，如果使用了匹配的伤害类型击破护盾，则可生成一个能量球。

perkDetails.name: Strand Soldier
perkDetails.description: Your Strand weapons gain Unraveling Rounds whenever you gain Woven Mail while your Strand or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 装备缚丝或棱镜分支职业时，每当你获得织造铠甲时你的缚丝武器都可获得瓦解弹药。

perkDetails.name: Suppressing Glaive
perkDetails.description: Damaging combatants with your Glaive suppresses them, preventing them from using abilities for a short time.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用偃月对战斗人员造成伤害可压制他们，使其在短时间内无法使用技能。

perkDetails.name: Protective Breach
perkDetails.description: Picking up a Void Breach gives you an overshield or refreshes your existing overshield.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你获得一个覆盖护盾或刷新你现有的覆盖护盾。

perkDetails.name: Counter Charge
perkDetails.description: Gain a stack of Armor Charge when you stun a Champion.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你眩晕一名勇士时，可获得一层护甲充能。

perkDetails.name: Bricks from Beyond
perkDetails.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a Void weapon has a chance to generate Heavy ammo progress for you and your teammates.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用虚空武器击败强力战斗人员有几率为你和队友生成重型弹药进度。

perkDetails.name: Overload Grenades
perkDetails.description: Void grenades disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 虚空手雷会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

perkDetails.name: Targeting Autoloader
perkDetails.description:
While you have an Auto Rifle equipped, defeating combatants reloads your equipped weapon and temporarily increases weapon damage. 

Awards bonus progress when dealing final blows while surrounded.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
装备自动步枪时，击败战斗人员将重新填装你装备的武器，并暂时提高武器伤害。

被包围时造成最后一击可提供额外进度。

perkDetails.name: Conductive Cosmic Needle
perkDetails.description: Targets affected by Strand debuffs take increased damage from Arc and Void abilities.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 受缚丝减益效果影响的目标会受到更高的电弧和虚空技能伤害。

perkDetails.name: Shock and Awe
perkDetails.description: Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 处于增幅状态时造成电弧最后一击可召唤出一道闪电，伤害并震颤目标。

perkDetails.name: Supernova
perkDetails.description: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你的下一次虚空伤害来源生成一次大型的削弱脉冲。

perkDetails.name: Squad Goals
perkDetails.description:
Performing a finisher while you are amplified grants Amplified to nearby allies. 

Performing a finisher while you have Woven Mail grants Woven Mail to nearby allies. 

Performing a finisher while you have Devour grants Devour to nearby allies.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
在增幅状态下发动终结技可为附近盟友提供增幅状态。

拥有织造铠甲时发动终结技可为附近盟友提供织造铠甲。

在吞食状态下发动终结技可为附近盟友提供吞食状态。

perkDetails.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
perkDetails.description: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 投掷电弧手雷后，短时间内手雷充能速度加快。电弧最后一击会延长此增益的持续时间。

perkDetails.name: Passive Aggressive Guard
perkDetails.description: Receive less damage from combatants that are close to you while you are wielding a Glaive.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 挥舞偃月时，你附近的战斗人员对你造成的伤害降低。

perkDetails.name: Void Weapon Channeling
perkDetails.description: You gain a temporary bonus to Void weapon damage after you defeat a target with a Void weapon while at least one of your Void abilities is fully charged. This damage bonus increases based on the number of fully charged Void abilities you have.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你用一把虚空武器击败目标，且至少有一个虚空技能完全充能时，你将获得临时的虚空武器伤害加成。该伤害加成根据你完全充能的虚空技能的数量而提升。

items.note: 复刻神器：按官方插槽配置；不代表账号已解锁或当前活动允许使用。

items.description:
Works best with:
Elements: [Stasis] [Void] [Arc]
Weapons: [Grenade Launcher] [Special Grenade Launcher] [Shotgun]
items.descriptionZh:
最佳搭配：
元素：  
武器：  

perkDetails.name: Wind Chill
perkDetails.description: Rapid [Stasis] Stasis weapon hits grant you a stack of Frost Armor; hits against slowed or frozen targets also create a Stasis Shard.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 快速冰影武器命中会提供一层冰霜护甲；命中被减速或被冻结的目标还会生成一个冰影碎片。

perkDetails.name: Crystalline Converter
perkDetails.description:
After activating your class ability, your next [Stasis] Stasis weapon final blow creates a Stasis Shard. 

Gather Stasis Shards to gain stacks of Crystalline Converter, which cause your next powered Stasis melee hit to create Stasis crystals equal to the number of stacks you have.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能后，你下一次冰影武器最后一击会生成一个冰影碎片。

收集冰影碎片来获得晶体转换器层数，使你下一次充能冰影近战命中生成冰影水晶，数量等同于你拥有的层数。

perkDetails.name: Total Carnage
perkDetails.description: After finishing a powerful combatant, gain temporary damage resistance and replenish health.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 终结一个强力战斗人员后，获得临时伤害抗性并回复生命值。

perkDetails.name: Power from Pain
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grants you Devour and creates a Void Breach.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被削弱的战斗人员造成快速最后一击为你提供吞食效果并生成一个虚空裂口。

perkDetails.name: Trace Evidence
perkDetails.description:
Rapid precision hits or rapid final blows on targets affected by Jolt or Blind will generate Ionic Traces.

Picking up an Ionic Trace grants an Armor Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
对受到震颤或致盲效果影响的目标造成快速精准命中或快速最后一击，会生成离子轨迹。

拾起离子轨迹会提供护甲充能。

perkDetails.name: The Thick of It
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows while surrounded grant you Armor Charge. While you are surrounded, your weapons have increased handling; Swords gain increased charge rate.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 被包围时，快速最后一击会为你提供护甲充能。你被包围时，武器的操控性提升。刀剑的充能速度提升。

perkDetails.name: Killing Breeze
perkDetails.description: Rapid weapon final blows grant you a bonus to mobility.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 快速武器最后一击会为你提供额外的敏捷。

perkDetails.name: Frost Renewal
perkDetails.description: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，受到暴击伤害会释放爆发冻结附近的战斗人员，并为你和附近的盟友提供冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Hail The Storm
perkDetails.description:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击碎被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更多伤害。

击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

perkDetails.name: Debilitating Wave
perkDetails.description:
Finishers emit a damaging wave that matches the element of your currently equipped Super.

Arc, Void, and Stasis waves apply Blind, Weaken, and Slow respectively.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
终结技会释放一道与当前已装备超能元素相匹配的伤害波。

电弧、虚空和冰影伤害波分别施加致盲、削弱和减速。

perkDetails.name: Weakened Clear
perkDetails.description: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and weakens the combatant.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当使用榴弹发射器的时候，对首领造成伤害、对勇士造成伤害、或打破战斗人员的护盾将填装你收起的武器并削弱战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Retinal Burn
perkDetails.description: Rapid [Arc] Arc weapon precision hits consume an Armor Charge to trigger a blinding burst at the target's location.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 快速电弧武器精准命中会消耗一层护甲充能，在目标位置触发一次致盲爆发。

perkDetails.name: Curative Orbs
perkDetails.description:
The first time you break a target's shield or break the shield of a Guardian using their Super, you create an Orb of Power.

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle grants you a small amount of health.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
你首次击破目标的护盾，或击破使用超能的守护者的护盾时，会生成一个能量球。

收集元素拾取物、能量球，或是摧毁缠结会为你提供少量生命值。

perkDetails.name: Void Renewal
perkDetails.description:
While Devour is active, [Void] Void weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Void Breach.

Picking up a Void Breach increases weapon reload and handling; Shotguns and Grenade Launchers are also reloaded from reserves.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
吞食生效时，虚空武器最后一击有几率生成一个虚空裂口。

拾取虚空裂口可提升武器填装和操控性；霰弹枪和榴弹发射器也会从备弹中填装。

perkDetails.name: Brain Freeze
perkDetails.description: Frozen combatants become surrounded by chilling fog, which slows combatants that aren't already.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 被冻结的战斗人员受到寒冷雾气包围，减速尚未被减速的战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Supernova
perkDetails.description: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你的下一次虚空伤害来源生成一次大型的削弱脉冲。

perkDetails.name: Conductive Cosmic Crystal
perkDetails.description: Your [Arc] Arc and [Void] Void abilities deal bonus damage to targets that are affected by a [Stasis] Stasis debuff.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的电弧和虚空技能对受到冰影减益影响的目标造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: Served Cold
perkDetails.description:
Picking up a [Stasis] Stasis Shard grants you class ability energy. 

Picking up a [Void] Void Breach grants you melee energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会赋予你职业技能能量。

拾取虚空裂口会赋予你近战能量。

perkDetails.name: Kinetic Impacts
perkDetails.description:
Sustained damage with a Grenade Launcher increases the reload speed of Grenade Launchers and triggers a damaging Kinetic shockwave.

This shockwave can stun [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用榴弹发射器造成持续伤害会提升榴弹发射器的填装速度，并触发造成伤害的动能冲击波。

此冲击波可以眩晕势不可挡勇士。

perkDetails.name: Arc Compounding
perkDetails.description: [Arc] Arc sources deal increased damage to Blind targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 电弧来源对被致盲目标造成的伤害增加。

perkDetails.name: Old God's Rite
perkDetails.description: After picking up a [Void] Void Breach, dealing damage with a Void weapon creates a rain of seeking projectiles.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口后，使用虚空武器造成伤害会生成追踪射弹雨。

items.note: 复刻神器：按官方插槽配置；不代表账号已解锁或当前活动允许使用。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Siphon
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。

perkDetails.name: Energy Diffusion Substrate
perkDetails.description: Gain a small amount of resistance to all damage dealt to you by combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 小幅减少战斗人员对你造成的伤害。

perkDetails.name: Creeping Chill
perkDetails.description: Stasis final blows against slowed or frozen targets release a burst that slows combatants and grants Frost Armor to allies caught in the blast.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被减速或被冻结的目标造成冰影最后一击会释放可减速战斗人员的冲击波，并为范围内的盟友赋予冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Press The Advantage
perkDetails.description: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾可以提高武器的稳定性、操控性和填装速度。刀剑可获得更高的防御抗性。

perkDetails.name: Threaded Blast
perkDetails.description: Destroying a Tangle with a Strand weapon creates a larger and more damaging explosion.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝武器摧毁缠结可造成更大、伤害更高的爆炸。

perkDetails.name: Incendiary Rifle Rounds
perkDetails.description: Solar Sniper Rifle precision hits scorch targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 烈日狙击步枪精准命中可灼烧目标。

perkDetails.name: Sustained Fire
perkDetails.description: Continuously damaging combatants or healing allies with an Auto Rifle grants you damage resistance.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用自动步枪持续对战斗人员造成伤害或治疗盟友可提供伤害抗性。

perkDetails.name: Counter Energy
perkDetails.description: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，你充能最少的技能将获得能量。

perkDetails.name: Blade Stamina
perkDetails.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with a Sword refunds some ammo.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用刀剑快速击败战斗人员会返还一些弹药。

perkDetails.name: Void Hegemony
perkDetails.description: While you have a Void or Prismatic subclass equipped, defeating weakened targets provides a small Void Overshield.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你装备了虚空或棱镜分支职业时，击败被削弱的目标会提供一个小型虚空覆盖护盾。

perkDetails.name: Radiant Orbs
perkDetails.description: While you have a Solar or Prismatic subclass equipped, picking up an Orb of Power makes you radiant.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你装备烈日或棱镜分支职业时，拾取能量球可获得焕光效果。

perkDetails.name: Bad Amplitude
perkDetails.description: Damaging a Champion with an Arc ability causes the Champion to become jolted.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用电弧技能伤害勇士会使其震颤。

perkDetails.name: Solar Fulmination
perkDetails.description: Your ignitions do increased damage in an increased radius.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 你的点燃会在更大的半径范围内造成更高伤害。

perkDetails.name: Targeting Autoloader
perkDetails.description:
While you have an Auto Rifle equipped, defeating combatants reloads your equipped weapon and temporarily increases weapon damage. 

Awards bonus progress when dealing final blows while surrounded.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
装备自动步枪时，击败战斗人员将重新填装你装备的武器，并暂时提高武器伤害。

被包围时造成最后一击可提供额外进度。

perkDetails.name: Prismatic Transfer
perkDetails.description: When you cast your Super, each member of your fireteam with a Super type different than yours gains a bonus to weapon damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施放超能时，你的火力战队中与你的超能类型不同的每位成员可获得武器伤害加成。

perkDetails.name: Argent Blade
perkDetails.description: While you have Armor Charge, dealing damage with a Sword consumes an Armor Charge and empowers your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and energy charge rate.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你有护甲充能时，使用刀剑造成伤害会消耗护甲充能，并在短时间内为你的刀剑赋能，使其获得额外伤害和充能速度。

perkDetails.name: Expanding Abyss
perkDetails.description: Void sources deal increased damage to weakened targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 虚空来源对被削弱目标造成的伤害增加。

perkDetails.name: Shieldcrush
perkDetails.description:
While you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or a Void Overshield, your melee recharges faster and deals increased damage.

While you are amplified or radiant, your grenade recharges faster and deals increased damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，你的 近战充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

当你处于增幅或焕光状态时，你的 手雷充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

perkDetails.name: Transference
perkDetails.description:
Gain increased grenade and melee damage while transcendent.

Weapon final blows while transcendent refund Light and Dark energy after Transcendence ends.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
处于超凡状态时，可获得更高的手雷和 近战伤害。

处于超凡状态时，武器最后一击在超凡结束后可返还光能和暗影能量。

perkDetails.name: Sniper's Meditation
perkDetails.description: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

perkDetails.name: Shock and Awe
perkDetails.description: When you have an Arc or Prismatic subclass equipped, Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 装备电弧或棱镜分支职业的情况下，处于增幅状态时造成电弧最后一击可召唤出一道闪电，伤害并震颤目标。

perkDetails.name: Fever and Chill
perkDetails.description: Rapid precision hits with [Solar]Solar weapons grant Radiant. Rapid precision hits with [Stasis]Stasis weapons grant Frost Armor.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用烈日武器快速精准命中目标可获得焕光。使用冰影武器快速精准命中目标可获得冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Torch
perkDetails.description: While radiant, deal increased weapon damage to combatants affected by Strand and Stasis debuffs.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 处于焕光状态时，对受缚丝和冰影减益影响的战斗人员造成更多武器伤害。

perkDetails.name: Heart of the Flame
perkDetails.description: Casting your Solar Super grants nearby allies radiant and increases the damage of your Super for each nearby ally.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 施放烈日超能会使附近盟友进入焕光状态，而且附近的盟友越多，超能的伤害就越高。

perkDetails.name: Armorsmith
perkDetails.description: Breaking a combatant's shield temporarily grants you damage resistance and increased melee damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾会暂时获得伤害抗性和近战伤害提升。

perkDetails.name: Wished into Being
perkDetails.description: While your Super is nearly fully-charged, ability final blows spawn Orbs of Power.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你的超能几乎完全充满时，技能最后一击会生成能量球。

perkDetails.name: Kindling Trigger
perkDetails.description: Radiant causes Solar weapons to apply scorch to unscorched combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 焕光会使烈日武器获得灼烧未被灼烧的战斗人员的能力。

perkDetails.name: Blast Radius
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows with Rocket Launchers and Grenade Launchers grant Armor Charge.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 火箭发射器和榴弹发射器快速最后一击会提供护甲充能。

perkDetails.name: Unraveling Orbs
perkDetails.description: Picking up an Orb of Power or a Tangle grants [Strand]Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球或缠结会使 缚丝武器获得瓦解弹药。

perkDetails.name: Pillar of Ice
perkDetails.description: Defeating a frozen target spawns Stasis crystals.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 击败被冻结目标会生成冰影水晶。

perkDetails.name: Revitalizing Blast
perkDetails.description: Stunning a Champion causes it to ignite and clears your shield stun.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士使其燃烧并清除你的护盾眩晕。

perkDetails.name: Anti-Champion Nosecone
perkDetails.description: Rocket Launchers deal increased damage to Champions.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 火箭发射器对勇士造成更高伤害。

perkDetails.name: Dragon's Bite
perkDetails.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with a Strand or Stasis weapon has a chance to suspend or freeze that combatant.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝或冰影武器打破战斗人员的护盾有几率悬停或冻结该战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Creeping Chill
perkDetails.description: Stasis final blows against slowed or frozen targets release a burst that slows combatants and grants Frost Armor to allies caught in the blast.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被减速或被冻结的目标造成冰影最后一击会释放可减速战斗人员的冲击波，并为范围内的盟友赋予冰霜护甲。

perkDetails.name: Perpetual Destruction
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows with non-Exotic Rocket Launchers refund ammo and increase reload speed for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用非异域火箭发射器造成快速最后一击，会返还弹药并在短时间内提升填装速度。

perkDetails.name: Horde Shuttle
perkDetails.description: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a Threadling. Threadlings sever targets that they damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。线虫会对其伤害到的目标施加割裂。

perkDetails.name: Hail The Storm
perkDetails.description:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击碎被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更多伤害。

击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

perkDetails.name: Rays of Precision
perkDetails.description: While radiant, Solar precision final blows cause combatants to ignite.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拥有焕光效果时，烈日精准最后一击可点燃战斗人员。

perkDetails.name: Solo Operative
perkDetails.description: While you are the only member of your fireteam, precision weapon final blows increase weapon damage until you are defeated.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 当你是火力战队的唯一成员时，精准武器最后一击会提升武器伤害，直至你被击败。

perkDetails.name: Argent Ordnance
perkDetails.description: Firing a Rocket Launcher consumes one stack of Armor Charge, granting increased damage and reload speed until you reload or stow your Rocket Launcher.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 发射火箭发射器会消耗一层护甲充能，在你填装或收起火箭发射器前可提升伤害和填装速度。

perkDetails.name: Frigid Glare
perkDetails.description: While Frost Armor is active, [Stasis]Stasis precision final blows cause combatants to release a freezing burst.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 冰霜护甲生效时，冰影精准最后一击会使战斗人员释放冻结爆发。

perkDetails.name: To Shreds
perkDetails.description: Dealing sustained damage to severed targets unravels them. Defeating a severed target creates a hotspot of Strand energy, granting Woven Mail to nearby allies for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被割裂的目标造成持续伤害会瓦解它们。击败被割裂的目标会生成一个缚丝能量热点，为附近的盟友在短时间内提供织造铠甲。

items.note: 复刻神器：按官方插槽配置；不代表账号已解锁或当前活动允许使用。

perkDetails.name: Hold the Line
perkDetails.description: While surrounded, Machine Guns and Glaives gain increased reload speed and stability; final blows heal you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 被包围时，机枪和偃月获得更高的填装速度和稳定性；最后一击会治疗你。

perkDetails.name: Dielectric
perkDetails.description:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
击败受到电弧减益的目标可获得电光充能。

快速击败受到电弧减益的目标会生成一个能量球并治疗一小部分生命值。

perkDetails.name: Volatile Marksman
perkDetails.description: Rapid [Void]Void weapon precision hits and rapid Void weapon final blows grant Volatile Rounds. Volatile detonations grant class ability energy.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 快速虚空武器精准命中和快速虚空武器最后一击会提供不稳定弹药。不稳定引爆会提供职业技能能量。

perkDetails.name: Unraveling Orbs
perkDetails.description: Picking up an Orb of Power or a Tangle grants [Strand]Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球或缠结会使 缚丝武器获得瓦解弹药。

perkDetails.name: Photonic Flare
perkDetails.description:
Defeating an exhausted or severed target with [Arc]Arc damage releases a blinding burst.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用电弧伤害击败疲惫或割裂的目标会释放致盲爆发。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Siphon
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super. Elemental pickups grant matching Super energy when they are collected.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。收集元素拾取物时会获得匹配的超能能量。

perkDetails.name: Perpetual Destruction
perkDetails.description: Rapid final blows with non-Exotic Rocket Launchers refund ammo and increase reload speed for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用非异域火箭发射器造成快速最后一击，会返还弹药并在短时间内提升填装速度。

perkDetails.name: Vile Weave
perkDetails.description: Targets hit by your Tangles are severed. Reduce Tangle cooldown by picking one up.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 被你的缠结击中的目标会被割裂。拾取缠结会减少缠结冷却。

perkDetails.name: Maligned Harvest
perkDetails.description: Rapidly applying Volatile causes your next instance of [Void]Void weapon damage to create a weakening burst. Applying Weaken provides a small Void Overshield.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 快速施加不稳定会使你的下一次虚空武器伤害产生削弱爆发。施加削弱会提供少量虚空覆盖护盾。

perkDetails.name: Flashover
perkDetails.description: When you gain maximum Bolt Charge, you also become amplified. Lightning bolts deal more damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 获得最大电光充能时，你也会获得增幅。闪电造成更多伤害。

perkDetails.name: Horde Shuttle
perkDetails.description: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a Threadling. Threadlings sever targets that they damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。线虫会对其伤害到的目标施加割裂。

perkDetails.name: No Bell
perkDetails.description: Rapid Glaive melee final blows grant Special ammo Glaives additional ammo. Blocking damage with Glaives increases their melee damage to targets.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 快速偃月近战最后一击会为特殊弹药偃月提供额外弹药。用偃月阻挡伤害会增加它们对目标的近战伤害。

perkDetails.name: Harsh Refraction
perkDetails.description: Trace Rifles do more damage to targets afflicted by elemental debuffs matching their element type.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 追踪步枪对受到与其元素类型相匹配的元素减益影响的目标造成更多伤害。

perkDetails.name: Gold from Lead
perkDetails.description: Picking up Special ammo has the chance to grant Heavy ammo.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊弹药有机会获得重型弹药。

perkDetails.name: Particle Reconstruction
perkDetails.description: Dealing sustained damage with Fusion Rifles or Linear Fusion Rifles partially refills the magazine from reserves and grants them bonus damage for a short duration against that target.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 用融合步枪或线性融合步枪造成持续伤害会从弹药储备中部分填充弹匣，并在短时间内对该目标造成额外伤害。

perkDetails.name: Elemental Supercharger
perkDetails.description:
Defeating exhausted or severed targets with weapons that match your Super element grants Super energy.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用与超能元素匹配的武器击败疲惫或割裂的目标会获得超能能量。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perkDetails.name: Heavy Ordnance Regeneration
perkDetails.description: Dealing sustained damage to targets with a Heavy Machine Gun or Rocket Launcher grants damage resistance and increases grenade and melee regeneration for a short duration. While active, defeating powerful combatants disorients nearby rank-and-file combatants.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 使用重型机枪或火箭发射器对目标造成持续伤害会获得伤害抗性，并在短时间内增加手雷和近战回复。生效期间击败强力战斗人员会使附近的普通战斗人员迷失方向。

perkDetails.name: Defibrillating Blast
perkDetails.description: Stunning a Champion grants maximum stacks of Bolt Charge. Damaging targets with Bolt Charge bolts jolts them and heals you.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士会提供最大层数的电光充能。用电光充能的弩弹对目标造成伤害会震颤他们并治疗你自己。

perkDetails.name: Void Flux
perkDetails.description:
Defeating weakened targets with a [Void] Void weapon applies Volatile to nearby targets.
Powerful targets increase the radius of the explosion.
perkDetails.descriptionZh:
使用虚空武器击败被削弱的目标会对附近目标施加不稳定。
强力目标增加爆炸半径。

perkDetails.name: Limit Break
perkDetails.description: Casting a Super while you are critically wounded or have a elemental buff matching your Super element grants a period of increased Super damage.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 重伤或拥有与超能元素相匹配的元素增益时施放超能，会在一段时间内提升超能伤害。

perkDetails.name: To Shreds
perkDetails.description: Dealing sustained damage to severed targets unravels them. Defeating a severed target creates a hotspot of Strand energy, granting Woven Mail to nearby allies for a short duration.
perkDetails.descriptionZh: 对被割裂的目标造成持续伤害会瓦解它们。击败被割裂的目标会生成一个缚丝能量热点，为附近的盟友在短时间内提供织造铠甲。
